concept.controls: - Use 'Arrows' or 'WASD' to aim the arrow. Hold 'Space' to charge and release it to putt. Press 'Enter' to start and restart.
concept.core_mechanic: The windmill really works: after a putt, you gently tilt the whole course with 'Arrows' or 'WASD', rolling the ball around sand and walls, and the faster the windmill blades spin, the harder the course tilts.
concept.juice: - Gamepad or 'Arrows' and 'WASD' move the ball once per hole: the ball stretches on impact, squashes on hard knocks, slows in sand, and stops at the hole. Keep 'Enter' near your thumb to undo changes quickly.
concept.lose: Finish 'Out of Bounds' if the ball flies into the rough or sits in any sand trap for three seconds. Use Undo (Enter) to pull the ball back.
concept.palette: - The ball is a glowing white orb, the flag is a bright red beacon, the bridge over the pond is the only safe crossing, the windmill obstacles guard the back fairway, and the pond is blue glass.
concept.pitch: A classic mini-golf hole with a twist: the windmill isn't an obstacle - it's your steering wheel. Every time you putt, you don't just watch, you drive the ball to the flag past the pond. The first hole is a gentle curve, but the windmill gets quicker and the pond gets bigger with each round.

roles.role: You putt the white golf ball around the one hole, mostly using curves and ramps. Aim and hold to power your shot.
The red flag plants the hole at the back of the screen - sink the ball there to win the hole.
A bright blue water hazard sits between you and the hole. If the ball goes in, it costs a stroke.
The windmill blade slowly spins over a narrow exit, and it also pushes wind across the field when you steer. Tap a blade and the ball bounces off.
The arched bridge sits over the pond - if you roll onto it, your ball crosses safely; the wind can't move you while you're on it.

concept.title: Windmill Steering Golf
concept.win: You win by holing the ball in the cup under the flag in 5 strokes or fewer.

playtest.advice: Winnable, and no dumb policy wins.

runs.summary: Windmill Steering Golf is a hand-drawn mini-golf game where you putt across a pond on a bridge, dodge sand and spinning windmill blades, and sink the ball by the red flag in five strokes or fewer. Aim with Arrows/WASD, hold and release Space to charge your putt, then keep steering the rolling ball by tilting the course with Arrows/WASD — pressing Enter to undo a bad shot.
